errors.evidence: The description identifies the 'mean' line as 'пунктирана' (dotted/dashed). While not strictly incorrect for a dashed line in Bulgarian, it is ambiguous and, more importantly, the same term is used to describe the 'min' line, which has a different, dash-dot style. A more precise description like 'прекъсната' or 'на тирета' (dashed) was needed to distinguish it from the other lines.

The description identifies the 'min' line as 'пунктирана' (dotted/dashed). This is incorrect as the line style is dash-dot. Furthermore, it uses the same term as for the 'mean' line, which has a dashed style, thus failing to visually distinguish between the two.
The value of the orange line (std) at layer 15 is approximately 0.15, not 0.16.
The value of the orange line (std) at layer 22 is approximately 0.13, not 0.14.
The green line (min) starts at a value of approximately 0.01 at layer 0, not 0.02.
